question: Chhajju Khan is one of the founder of which Gharana?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Bhendi Bazaar Gharana**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Bhendi Bazaar Gharana:**

 
 
• 
 
The** Bhendibazaar Gharana** is one of the significant gharanas recognized within the tradition of Indian classical music, concerning vocal performance. 

 
 
• 
 
The** foundation of this gharana** was laid in the **Bhendi Bazaar** area of **Mumbai, India**, in about **1890**.

 
 
• 
 
The founders were **three brothers**: **Chhajju Khan, Nazir Khan,** and **Khadim Hussain Khan**.

 
 
• 
 
Bhendibazaar Gharana members displayed a unique interpretation and approach to Indian classical music, contributing to the broad diversity and richness of this musical form.

 
 
• 
 
One of the prominent exponents of this gharana was** Aman Ali Khan (1888-1953)**, a disciple of the three founding brothers. His teaching propagated the Bhendibazaar Gharana’s traditions and ethos to the next generation.

 
 
• 
 
The story of the **Bhendibazaar Gharana** is one of **persistence, love for music, and challenging** the norms to carve out a unique space within the fabric of Indian classical music.

 
 
 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Mewati Gharana:**

 
 
• **Mewati Gharana** is a musical apprenticeship tribe of **Hindustani classical music** and is renowned for being the musical lineage of **Pandit Jasraj**.
 
• It was** founded** by Brother **Utd. Ghagge Nazir Khan** and** Utd. Wahid Khan** of **Indore** in the late **19th century **at the **Holkar Court**.
 
• The gharana is known for a traditional music style that places notable emphasis on the devotional aspect, particularly in the singing of **bhajans and abhangs**.
 
 
 
• **Agra Gharana**:
 
 
• **Agra Gharana** originated from **Rangeela Gharana**, given a distinct color by **Ustad Faiyyaz Khan**.
 
• Though not mentioned explicitly in the sources provided, the Agra Gharana is known for its extensive use of **nom-tom alap** and a unique approach to** khyal,** a genre of Hindustani classical music.
 
• The rich and powerful style of presentation in Agra Gharana is often considered masculine in nature.
 
 
 
• **Lucknow Gharana:**
 
 
• The **Lucknow Gharana** of **Kathak dance** was co-founded by **Kathak Durga Prasad Mishra** and his brother **Thakur Prasad Mishra** in the 19th century.
 
• **Durga Prasad Mishra** was also the father and guru of **Bindadin Maharaj** and **Kalka Prasad Mishra**, who further developed the gharana.
 
• Thakur Prasad Mishra served as the court dancer for the **Nawab of Awadh** and played a significant role in refining and codifying the style associated with this gharana.
